title: RUNNER.md connector entry: the showcase self-URL is frozen at compile time on a --no-compile boot, so exporting OS_PORT is not the fix there
body:
domain:devx#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5ooRyyS95kdyC2dPEX

Source: #32908 ledger row 94, measured live by the #33334 dev on `origin/main` `87330e89` (PR #33367, Acceptance notes and the row-94 line of its table). Filed by the devx seat as the route for that finding; #33367 deliberately wrote nothing for it.

## What is wrong

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`'s connector self-URL entry (about L305–L351 on `main`) says the showcase's declarative connectors follow an exported `OS_PORT`, cites QA run #25817 (measured before #26130), and prescribes **"boot with `OS_PORT=<port>` exported"** as the fix. RUNNER also prescribes `os dev --no-compile` on a shared checkout. The two do not compose:

- Artifact compiled with no `OS_PORT` → `dist/objectstack.json` carries `http://127.0.0.1:3000` four times.
- Boot `--no-compile` with `OS_PORT=41771` exported; a `showcase_task` create fires `showcase_declarative_connector_ping` → run `failed`, `connector_action(showcase_status_api.request) failed: fetch failed`.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/connector/showcase_status_api` → `baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:3000`; nothing listens on 3000.

## Why this is a RUNNER correction, not a runtime card

`examples/app-showcase/src/system/self-url.ts`'s header already states the behaviour as designed: `os dev` recompiles in the serving environment (#26130) "except under `os dev --no-compile`, which serves the metadata as last built", and on the artifact path the value "is frozen at BUILD time — set the env for the build, not just the boot". The product matches its own documentation; RUNNER's entry is what is stale. (If the maintainer later wants the declarative instance to follow the serving environment on a `--no-compile` boot, that is a separate runtime card; nothing here asks for it.)

## Scope

Docs only, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`:

1. Rewrite the connector self-URL entry to the measured fact: on a `--no-compile` (or `--artifact`) boot the self-URL is whatever the last compile saw; `OS_PORT` at boot time does not move it. Name the working routes, each re-measured before it is written: compile in a private copy with the run's `OS_PORT` (or `SHOWCASE_SELF_URL`) exported, or set `SHOWCASE_SELF_URL`/`OS_PORT` for a run that compiles — and say which of them is safe on a shared checkout (a compile rewrites the shared `dist/objectstack.json`).
2. Keep the "a `fetch failed` here impersonates an egress block" warning; date-stamp the #25817 reading as pre-#26130.
3. Fold in the #33367 dev's second observation in the same entry or the port entry: `os dev` shifts to the next free port when the requested one is held (`plugin-hono-server` adapter `listen` tries `targetPort + attempt`) and prints the shift, while the runner's shell keeps its own `OS_PORT` value — read the port from the boot log, not from the variable.

Out of scope: any change to `self-url.ts`, the showcase connectors or the CLI.

## Acceptance

- The entry no longer prescribes exported `OS_PORT` as the fix on a `--no-compile` boot.
- Each prescribed route is backed by a live measurement recorded in the PR (connector dispatch succeeds, `meta/connector` baseUrl shows the run's port).
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` and the derived gates exit 0.

Priority p2 (QA-runner correctness; a wrong recipe scores a correct product as BLOCKED). Serial: after #33367 merges (same file).
